fields.name: target_locations
fields.description: Read the requested colors in instruction order and initialize an ordered list of their visible cube world [x,y] locations using calibration. Match each descending cover to the cube underneath. Using the carried locations and tracking_frame, follow those specific containers through the cycle's chronological frames and write their latest [x,y] locations. Follow motion through exchanges rather than relabeling by nearest initial slot or final left-to-right order. Keep tracking a later requested target during button pressing and the earlier pickup. Preserve the last reliable location during temporary occlusion; use a newly exposed cube to confirm the association. e.g. [[0.02, -0.18], [0.03, 0.13]]
fields.annotation: Ordered list of world [x,y] locations of the containers associated with the cube colors requested in the instruction, in requested pickup order. Before covering, use the corresponding visible cube locations. At covering, associate each cube with the container descending over it. Subsequently follow that container continuously through every shuffle; its initial table slot is not its identity. Update to the last observed location each cycle, retaining a location through temporary arm occlusion. Track only requested targets, including the second target while manipulating the first. Do not assign an unseen color from the final arrangement alone. e.g. [[0.02, -0.18], [0.03, 0.13]]

fields.name: tracking_frame
fields.description: Write the label of the latest frame shown this cycle in which all still-needed target containers, or initially uncovered target cubes, can be localized without arm occlusion. If none qualifies, carry the previous label. At the first cycle write E0. Use this retained image with target_locations to establish identities at the beginning of the next clip. e.g. "E114"
fields.annotation: Label of the latest shown front frame in which all still-needed target containers, or their initially uncovered cubes, can be localized without arm occlusion. Retain the preceding value if no such frame appears in the cycle. This image anchors correspondence between the stored target locations and the next motion clip. Initialize with E0. e.g. "E114"

fields.name: interaction_state
fields.description: Initialize start. Update from observed outcomes and the incoming milestone, not from the action you are about to choose. A completed approach above the robot-left button gives left_hover; its subsequent short close-only motion gives left_ready; descent to button contact gives left_pressed; upward withdrawal gives left_retracted. Apply the analogous right_hover, right_ready, right_pressed, right_retracted milestones at the robot-right button. In particular, arrival with already-closed fingers is still right_hover, not right_ready: the separate short closing action must be observed. Opening after right_retracted gives buttons_finished. Arrival above the next requested container at about 0.20 m gives target_hover; descending and closing around it near 0.063 m gives target_grasped; lifting it clear near 0.20 m gives target_lifted; lowering and opening near 0.07 m gives target_released; withdrawing the empty hand near 0.15 m gives target_cleared. A subsequent approach to the next target returns to target_hover. Retain the incoming state if the expected outcome has not occurred or no control steps executed. e.g. "right_ready"
fields.annotation: Observed interaction milestone, initially start. Button milestones are left_hover, left_ready, left_pressed, left_retracted, right_hover, right_ready, right_pressed, right_retracted, buttons_finished. Hover means the initial approach to that button has finished; ready means the subsequent short closing action has finished, even if the fingers were already closed on arrival. Pressed means the closed hand has descended into button contact; retracted means it has subsequently risen to approximately 0.15 m. buttons_finished means the hand has subsequently opened above the right button. Container milestones are target_hover, target_grasped, target_lifted, target_released, target_cleared. They respectively mean arrival at the selected container's 0.20 m approach, closure around it near 0.063 m, successful lift near 0.20 m, lowering and opening near 0.07 m, and empty-hand withdrawal near 0.15 m. Change only when the corresponding motion outcome is observed, never when its waypoint is selected. e.g. "right_ready"

fields.name: pickups_completed
fields.description: Initialize zero. Increment only when the incoming state is target_grasped and the current clip shows the held requested container successfully raised clear to about 0.20 m, ordinarily revealing its colored cube. Carry the count unchanged in every other situation, including further views of that same held container. e.g. 1
fields.annotation: Number of requested containers successfully lifted in instruction order. Initialize to zero. Increment once when a newly grasped requested container is visibly raised off the table to approximately 0.20 m, exposing its cube. Do not increment for grasp closure, release, withdrawal, or repeated observations of the same lift. e.g. 1

action:
Use the incoming memory together with outcomes visible this cycle to determine the current milestone; write those observations for the next cycle. Begin by locating both buttons and all requested colored cubes. Robot-left is larger world y, appearing on the right of the front image. Estimate geometry with the calibrated cameras, intersecting image rays with the appropriate object surface height rather than treating elevated tops as table points. Use wrist imagery to refine alignment. Do not reuse episode-specific coordinates.

Button rules: From start, approach the robot-left button center at z=0.15 m, orientation [-3.1416,0,0], gripper open. At left_hover, command closure above the same center at z=0.15. At left_ready, descend over that center to commanded z=0.0075, closed. Actual contact may stop the TCP near z=0.024; this counts as contact, not a reason to press deeper. At left_pressed, retract to z=0.15 closed. At left_retracted, approach the robot-right button center at z=0.15 with an open command. At right_hover, perform the separate short closing action above the button even when the reported fingers are already closed. At right_ready, descend to z=0.0075 closed. At right_pressed, retract to z=0.15 closed. At right_retracted, open above the same button. Continue observing and tracking container exchanges throughout all these motions. Neither a return to the original spatial arrangement nor an unchanged shell appearance resets its hidden color association.

Container rules: After buttons_finished, select target_locations[pickups_completed]. At target_cleared, select that same indexed next uncompleted target. Approach its current center at z=0.20, open, pointing straight down. Choose yaw from its visible square edges so the fingers grasp opposing sides; use an equivalent square-symmetry orientation near zero where possible. At target_hover, descend to the container center at z=0.0633–0.0634 and close. At target_grasped, raise to z=0.20 closed, keeping the grasp orientation and approximately the container center's x,y; a small visual centering correction is appropriate. Fingers stopped around 0.018 m each and a container between them support a successful grasp.

At target_lifted, if more requested pickups remain, lower the held container over its current location to z=0.07 and open, preserving current orientation. At target_released, withdraw vertically with open fingers to approximately z=0.149 before moving laterally to the next target. The completed pickup remains completed even though its cube is covered again. After lifting the final requested container, retain the grasp for automatic success; do not initiate an unnecessary release.

Never issue an exactly identical TCP pose merely to change the gripper. If the nominal close/open waypoint is within 2 mm of the current pose, add a small vertical displacement of about 3 mm while retaining the required gripper command. Allow normal motion error when recognizing arrival; do not require exact equality.

If an expected motion did not execute, retain memory milestones and retry with a reachable, nonidentical waypoint. If alignment or grasp is visibly unsuccessful, correct using the current wrist image instead of advancing progress. If a target is temporarily occluded, first withdraw safely to reveal it. If containers are still moving and correspondence needs another observation, a short purposeful wait of 8 control steps may be used to finish tracking before a grasp. Do not guess a hidden color from its original slot, and do not wait without a specific visibility or settling purpose.
